title: Reynolds-number study: results since the figure relabelling

p: Everything produced from the request to relabel the study's figures to the end of the run queue, in the order it happened: the relabelled figures, runs 8, 2 and 6, the six seed runs, and the comparisons made as each finished. J is in μU_c/h at Re_h ≤ 1 and ρU_c² above. Argmin error = PINN s* − reference s*; regret = J_ref(s*_PINN)/J_ref* − 1; pressure-drop error = J_PINN/J_ref − 1 at the same split. 'Converged' = the schedule finished, every loss finite, and the best held-out loss of the last 25 LM steps not more than 10% below the best before them.

note: 30/90 over seeds 21–23; Re_h 1 has seed 21 only (docs/re_study/seeds_30-90.md).

bullets: H3, 30/90: the PINN locates the optimum within the ±0.002 search tolerance on average at Re_h 10 (+0.0009 ± 0.0005); it is biased at Re_h 0.1 (+0.0034 ± 0.0021) and scattered at Re_h 100 (−0.0019 ± 0.0029). Regret stays below 0.06% in every 30/90 run.

30/120: only at Re_h 100 is there an interior optimum in the range; the PINN misses it by 0.014 (regret 0.08%). At Re_h 0.1, 1 and 10 the optimum sits on the range's bound (run 5 was stopped for that reason).

Accuracy against Reynolds number: the drop error at the range's edge is about 1% at Re_h 10 and grows toward both ends, to 2.6–4.6% at Re_h 0.1 and 2.9–4.0% at Re_h 100 for 30/90, and 7.6% for 30/120 at Re_h 1.
Convergence: only one run (30/90, Re_h 100, seed 23) met the definition within the fixed schedule; all others were still improving at the end.
Code check after the last run: the fast test suite passed (805 passed, 5 skipped, 2 expected failures).

Figure 2. Pressure-drop error of each PINN against the reference solution at the seven evaluation splits; zero is a perfect prediction.

Figure 3. Held-out loss against training time for every run; squares mark the start of L-BFGS, triangles of Levenberg–Marquardt. A diagnostic only: its scale differs between the viscous (Re_h ≤ 1) and inertial runs.
